title: Jammu and Kashmir’s selection board’s official X handle ‘suspended’ amid anti-board protests over cheating case

ai.summary: Protests in Jammu and Kashmir over alleged cheating in selection board exams have led to the suspension of the official X handle of the Jammu and Kashmir selection board.

facts.claim: Protests in Jammu and Kashmir over alleged cheating in selection board exams
facts.quote: Jammu and Kashmir’s selection board’s official X handle ‘suspended’ amid anti-board protests over cheating case

ai.background_note: The Jammu and Kashmir selection board is part of the statehood movement, which has been protesting since 2019 after J&K lost statehood.
